# Tool Catalog

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:tools`. Do not edit by hand. -->

33 built-in tools. MCP tools are not listed here — they come from whatever servers are connected.

## `ask_user_question`

Ask the user a question when you need a decision, a choice, or information only they have, and proceeding on a guess would produce materially different work. Blocks until they answer. Prefer making routine judgement calls yourself.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `questions` | array of object | yes | One or more questions to ask before continuing. |

## `audit_dvm_contract`

Run a comprehensive DERO DVM-BASIC security audit against a fixed checklist. Reviews access control, fund safety, state integrity, reentrancy, overflow, initialization, denial-of-service, and privacy. Returns findings with severity, affected lines, exploit paths, and remediations.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | yes | Full DVM-BASIC contract source code to audit. |
| `contractName` | string | no | Optional contract name for context. |

## `discover_contracts`

Discover DERO smart contracts indexed by Gnomon. Search by function name, similarity, transaction history, or TELA apps. Results include SCID, deployment height, functions, and related contracts.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | no | Search query: a function name, SCID, or keyword to find related contracts. |
| `kind` | string | no | Search kind: similar-contracts, by-function, by-transaction, or tela-apps. Default: similar-contracts. |

## `edit_file`

Replace exact text in a file. Pass "edits" to apply several replacements to the same file in one atomic call — either all of them apply or the file is left untouched. Each old_text must match uniquely unless replace_all is set.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `edits` | array of object | no | Ordered replacements. Each one sees the result of the previous. Preferred over old_text/new_text. |
| `old_text` | string | no | Single-edit form. Exact text to replace. |
| `new_text` | string | no | Single-edit form. Replacement text. |
| `replace_all` | boolean | no | Single-edit form. Replace every occurrence. |

## `generate_audio`

Generate spoken audio (text-to-speech) from text and save it for the user. Use when the user asks you to say something aloud, narrate, or produce a voiceover.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes | The text to speak. |
| `voice` | string | no | Optional voice name (e.g. alloy, nova) or ElevenLabs voice id. |

## `generate_dvm_contract`

Generate a complete DVM-BASIC smart contract from a plain-language specification. The model should provide a detailed brief describing actors, assets, state variables, access rules, functions, failure cases, and test scenarios. This tool validates the structure with the DVM linter.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Contract name (PascalCase, e.g. "Token", "Lottery", "Vault"). |
| `brief` | string | yes | Detailed contract specification: actors, state, access rules, functions, failure modes, and test cases. |

## `generate_image`

Generate an image from a text prompt and save it for the user. Use this whenever the user asks you to create, draw, or make an image/picture/illustration.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes | A detailed description of the image to generate. |
| `aspect` | `square` \| `portrait` \| `landscape` | no | Aspect ratio. Default square. |

## `generate_tela_dapp`

Scaffold a complete TELA dApp project including DVM-BASIC contract, HTML/CSS/JS frontend, XSWD wallet connection, mock fixtures, and deployment manifest.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | dApp name (used as directory name and contract name). |
| `description` | string | yes | Brief description of what the dApp does. |

## `generate_video`

Generate a short video from a text prompt and save it for the user. Requires a dedicated video-capable media provider (e.g. Replicate or ComfyUI).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes | A description of the video to generate. |
| `duration_seconds` | integer | no | Clip length in seconds (default 5). |

## `get_simulator_chain_info`

Read the local DERO simulator chain state from its loopback-only RPC endpoint (127.0.0.1:20000). Read-only; returns an error if the simulator is not running.

No parameters.

## `git_branch`

List branches, or create and switch to one. Listing is read-only; create and switch change the checkout.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cwd` | string | no |  |
| `create` | string | no | Create this branch from the current HEAD and switch to it. |
| `switch_to` | string | no | Switch to an existing branch. |
| `remote` | boolean | no | Include remote-tracking branches when listing. |

## `git_commit`

Commit staged changes. Set all to stage tracked modifications first. Never bypasses hooks.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cwd` | string | no |  |
| `message` | string | yes | Commit message. The first line is the subject. |
| `all` | boolean | no | Stage every tracked modified file first (git commit -a). Does not add untracked files. |
| `paths` | array of string | no | Stage exactly these paths before committing. |

## `git_diff`

Show a unified diff of the working tree. Read-only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cwd` | string | no |  |
| `path` | string | no | Limit the diff to one file or directory. |
| `staged` | boolean | no | Diff the index against HEAD instead of the working tree. |
| `base` | string | no | Diff against this ref (branch, tag or commit) instead of HEAD. |
| `stat` | boolean | no | Return a per-file summary instead of the full diff. |

## `git_log`

List recent commits: hash, author, date and subject. Read-only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cwd` | string | no |  |
| `max_count` | integer | no | How many commits to return. Default 20, max 200. |
| `path` | string | no | Only commits touching this path. |
| `author` | string | no | Only commits by this author (substring match). |

## `git_push`

Push commits to a remote. Always asks the user first, in every approval mode.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cwd` | string | no |  |
| `remote` | string | no | Remote name. Default origin. |
| `branch` | string | no | Branch to push. Defaults to the current branch. |
| `set_upstream` | boolean | no | Set the pushed branch as upstream (-u). |

## `git_status`

Show the working tree status: branch, tracking, staged, unstaged and untracked files. Read-only.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cwd` | string | no | Repository path. Defaults to the working directory. |

## `glob_files`

Find files matching a glob pattern. Example: "src/**/*.ts".

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pattern` | string | yes |  |
| `cwd` | string | no |  |
| `ignore` | array of string | no | Glob patterns to skip. Defaults skip node_modules, .git and dist. |

## `grep_files`

Search for a regex pattern across files. Returns file:line:content matches. Skips binary files and anything gitignored.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pattern` | string | yes |  |
| `cwd` | string | no |  |
| `include` | string | no | Glob filter, e.g. "*.ts" |
| `ignore` | array of string | no | Glob patterns to skip. |
| `max_results` | integer | no | Stop after this many matching lines. |

## `job_kill`

Stop a running background job and its child processes.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id` | string | yes |  |

## `job_list`

List background jobs for this conversation: id, what is running, status and exit code.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | boolean | no | Include jobs started by other conversations. Defaults to false. |

## `job_output`

Read output from a background job. Pass the cursor returned by the previous call to read only what is new.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id` | string | yes |  |
| `cursor` | integer | no | Character offset to resume from. Omit to read from the start. |
| `max_chars` | integer | no | Most characters to return in this call. Default 20000. |

## `lint_dvm_basic`

Run deterministic structural checks on DERO DVM-BASIC source. Read-only; this is not a compiler, so use a simulator or daemon gas estimate to confirm execution validity.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | string | yes | Complete DVM-BASIC smart-contract source code |

## `list_directory`

List files and subdirectories in a directory.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |

## `lsp`

Ask a language server about code: where a symbol is defined, what references it, what its type is, what is wrong with a file, or what it contains. Far more accurate than grep for these questions. Lines and columns are 1-based, as shown in editors and compiler errors. Returns LSP_UNAVAILABLE if no server is configured for this file type — fall back to grep_files then.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | `definition` \| `references` \| `hover` \| `diagnostics` \| `symbols` | yes | definition/references/hover need line and character; diagnostics and symbols work on the whole file. |
| `path` | string | yes | File to ask about. |
| `line` | integer | no | 1-based line of the symbol. |
| `character` | integer | no | 1-based column of the symbol. |

## `read_file`

Read the contents of a file. Returns text, or base64 for binary files. Supports line ranges.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Absolute or working-directory-relative path |
| `start_line` | integer | no | 1-based start line (optional) |
| `end_line` | integer | no | 1-based end line (optional, inclusive) |
| `encoding` | `utf-8` \| `base64` | no | Default utf-8; use base64 for binaries |

## `run_shell`

Execute a shell command. Output is captured stdout+stderr. Use with care.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | string | yes |  |
| `cwd` | string | no |  |
| `timeout_ms` | integer | no | Kill the command after this long. Ignored for background jobs. |
| `run_in_background` | boolean | no | Start the command and return immediately with a job id instead of waiting. Use for servers, watchers and long builds, then read it with job_output. |

## `simulator_create_wallet`

Create a new fixture wallet on the DERO simulator and return its address.

No parameters.

## `simulator_get_balance`

Get the encrypted balance for an address on the simulator.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | string | no | DERO address (dero1...) to check balance for. |
| `scid` | string | no | Optional SCID to check token balance; omit for native DERO. |

## `simulator_get_contract_state`

Read smart contract storage state from the simulator by SCID and optional keys.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scid` | string | no | Smart Contract ID (64-char hex). |
| `keys` | string | no | Comma-separated storage key names to read; omit for all keys. |

## `simulator_get_height`

Get the current block height of the running simulator.

No parameters.

## `todo_write`

Maintain a structured task list. Use for multi-step work to track progress.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `todos` | array of object | yes | The complete list, resent in full each time. Exactly one task should be in_progress. |

## `web_fetch`

Fetch a public http/https URL and return its text as markdown. Follows up to 5 redirects, caps the body at 2 MB, and refuses private, loopback and non-text targets.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | yes | Absolute http or https URL. |

## `write_file`

Write content to a file, creating parent directories as needed. Overwrites existing files.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `content` | string | yes |  |
